item.text: {"explanation":"The conditional rule is ancestry reconciliation over a persistent record graph: commit records atomically, walk both heads through known parents, report unknown terminal IDs, and classify equality, advancement, being ahead, fork, or unresolved ancestry. A conflicting batch is rejected without mutation, but its missing set is computed against the unchanged graph.","mapping":"Local variables map to the contract as follows: state.head is the local head; state.records is the immutable known ID-to-record graph; event.head is the remote head; event.records is the proposed atomic merge; output.head and output.decision report the resulting local head and relation; output.missing reports unknown walk terminals.","assumptions":"Inputs satisfy the stated legal JSON and graph constraints. JavaScript strings are compared by Unicode scalar values using an explicit code-point comparator, not UTF-16 ordering.","applies":"function applies(input){return !!input&&Array.isArray(input.events)}","holds":"function holds(input,output){return Array.isArray(output)&&output.length===input.events.length&&output.every(x=>x&&Object.keys(x).length===3&&typeof x.decision==='string'&&('head'in x)&&Array.isArray(x.missing))}","program":"function solve({config,state,event}){\\n  function cmp(a,b){let x=Array.from(a),y=Array.from(b),n=Math.min(x.length,y.length);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){let u=x[i].codePointAt(0),v=y[i].codePointAt(0);if(u!==v)return u-v}return x.length-y.length}\\n  let s=state||{head:null,records:{}};\\n  let r=s.records, bad=false, add={};\\n  for(let q of event.records){let old=r[q.id]||add[q.id];if(old&&(old.parent!==q.parent||old.value!==q.value)){bad=true;break}add[q.id]={parent:q.parent,value:q.value}}\\n  function walk(h){let seen={},miss={};let x=h;while(x!==null){if(!r[x]&&!(!bad&&add[x])){miss[x]=1;break}if(seen[x])break;seen[x]=1;x=(r[x]||add[x]).parent}return {seen:seen,term:x,miss:miss}}\\n  let a=walk(s.head),b=walk(event.head),m={};for(let x in a.miss)m[x]=1;for(let x in b.miss)m[x]=1;let missing=Object.keys(m).sort(cmp),out,ns=s;\\n  if(bad)out={head:s.head,decision:'conflict',missing};\\n  else{let d,h=s.head;if(s.head===event.head)d='same';else if((s.head===null?b.term===null:!!b.seen[s.head])){d='advance';h=event.head;ns={head:h,records:Object.assign({},r,add)}}else if((event.head===null?a.term===null:!!a.seen[event.head]))d='ahead';else if(a.term===null&&b.term===null)d='fork';else d='unknown';if(d==='advance')ns={head:h,records:Object.assign({},r,add)};out={head:ns.head,decision:d,missing}}return {state:ns,output:out}\\n}"}
